correctness.rationale: The full gap-index valuation proof covers every integer q>=3 and all n>=0: palindrome centers either contain a unique central 1, or are separated by a gap g_j; exact maximal symmetric extension M_j follows from valuations of m±2^j. Distinct centers and the all-zero factor exhaust every case. A second generation route and finite factor checks verified 560 pairs, but the infinite result is proved independently of finite tests.

value.rationale: The exact joint dependence on arbitrary substitution base q and palindrome length n, together with the gap-center classification and uniform bound P<=3, gives a natural complete structural invariant of generalized non-uniformly recurrent automatic Cantor words. It reveals parity and scale phase changes not given by older factor-count or prefix-decomposition tables.
